claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Three families QR=(1,3,bar3),QL=(bar3,1,3),L=(3,bar3,1); three complex H=(3,bar3,1). Table representation orientation and gauge-invariant QL QR H contraction are used as an all-LH Weyl basis; R in QR is a gauge-sector name, not a request to conjugate its already antifundamental colour twice.

One Majorana singlet Ni per generation yields three singlet Weyl copies. Alternative adjoint Majorana8L gives one Weyl adjoint. Do not union alternative mechanisms by default; keep the source-specific adjoint and singlet examples separate.
